MENU_QUICK_DESC: Dinaga dipe fela tse pedi, lefelo lepe fela. Centre pass ke ya gago.
MENU_CUP_DESC: Dinaga di le robedi, ditlhopha di le pedi, semi-final le final.
MENU_CUP_CONTINUE: Kopi ya gago e setse e simolotse. Tswelela.
MENU_HOWTO_DESC: Lebala, maemo a supa le molao mongwe le mongwe o batsereganyi ba o letsang.
QUARTERS_NOTE: Motshameko wa nnete ke dikotara di le nne tsa metsotso e 15. Nako ga e eme fa go tsenngwa kolo; e ema fela fa go na le kgobalo.
DOUBLE_ZONE_NOTE: Molao wa liki: mo metsotsong e metlhano ya bofelo ya kotara nngwe le nngwe, kolo e e tswang 3 m kgotsa go feta e na le dintlha di le pedi.
DIFF_EASY_DESC: Basireletsi ba bone ba bonya go bala dipase tsa gago mme ga ba ke ba di thopa.
DIFF_NORMAL_DESC: Setlhopha se se siameng sa tlelabo: se tla thopa pase e e bokoa.
DIFF_PRO_DESC: Setlhopha sa boditšhabatšhaba: se bala motshameko ka bonako, go thata go se fetisetsa.
DIFF_LEGEND_DESC: Ba ba gaisang mo lefatsheng. Pase nngwe le nngwe e e bokoa e a thopiwa.
BIB_TEAM_NOTE: O tshameka ka motshameki yo o nang le bolo, le mosireletsi yo o gaufi le yone.
PLAY_AS_NOTE: Setlhopha: o laola motshameki yo o nang le bolo. Boemo bo le bongwe: tlhopha bib mo sekirining sa gae mme o mo tshameke motshameko otlhe, jaaka motshameki wa nnete.
KEEP_ONSIDE_NOTE: Bulegile: motshameki wa gago o ema mo moeding wa mafelo a boemo jwa gagwe bo a letlang. Tswetswe: tlola mola mme motsereganyi o letsa offside.
POS_ROLE_GS: O tsenya dikolo a le gaufi le pala.
POS_ROLE_GA: O tsenya dikolo, o fetisetsa GS bolo mme o tsena ka thata mo karolong ya bogare.
POS_ROLE_WA: O fetisetsa bolo mo sedikong a le mo moeding wa sone; kgetho ya ntlha mo centre pass.
POS_ROLE_C: O tsaya centre pass mme o golaganya tshireletso le tlhaselo mo lebaleng lotlhe.
POS_ROLE_WD: O disa WA mme o kgaola dipase tse di yang mo sedikong.
POS_ROLE_GD: O disa GA, mo teng ga sediko le kwa ntle ga sone.
POS_ROLE_GK: O disa GS, o sireletsa go thuntsha mme o tsaya bolo e e boelang.
POS_AREAS_GS: Mafelo: karolo ya tlhaselo le sediko sa kolo.
POS_AREAS_GA: Mafelo: karolo ya bogare, karolo ya tlhaselo le sediko sa kolo.
POS_AREAS_WA: Mafelo: karolo ya bogare le karolo ya tlhaselo, e seng sediko.
POS_AREAS_C: Mafelo: dikarolo tsotlhe tse tharo, e seng sediko.
POS_AREAS_WD: Mafelo: karolo ya bogare le karolo ya tshireletso, e seng sediko.
POS_AREAS_GD: Mafelo: karolo ya bogare, karolo ya tshireletso le sediko sa kolo.
POS_AREAS_GK: Mafelo: karolo ya tshireletso le sediko sa kolo.
GFX_NOTE: Kwa tlase go siametse difounu tse di tlhwatlhwa e kwa tlase: ga go na mela ya dikgaolo, boidiidi bo bonnye. Fa "ka boitiriso" e bulegile, motshameko o o tsamayang ka bonya mo metsotswaneng ya ntlha o fologela kwa tlase.
FPS_NOTE_SAVER: Difreime di ka nna {n} ka motsotswana, di le dinnye go se kae: founu e tsididi mme beteri e nnela leruri.
FPS_NOTE_SMOOTH: Difreime di le {n} ka motsotswana mo sekirining sa gago sa {hz} Hz: di boreledi, e bile di boloka beteri go feta tse dintsi.
FPS_NOTE_MAX: Difreime di le dintsi jaaka sekirini sa gago sa {hz} Hz se ka di bontsha.
MOVE_BUTTONS_NOTE: Goga konopo nngwe le nngwe go ya kwa monwana wa gago o motona o e bonang teng. Di tla nna foo.
ABOUT_DISCLAIMER: Ono ke motshameko o o ikemetseng. Ditlhopha ke dinaga ka maina a tsone a a tlwaelegileng; leina la motshameki mongwe le mongwe le itlhametswe. Ga o amane le mokgatlho ope o o laolang, liki kgotsa kgaisano.
LICENCES_INTRO: Motshameko o agilwe ka software ya mahala e e bulegileng. Dilaesense tsa yone di kopa gore dikitsiso tse di bontshiwe; di ka Sekgoa, jaaka di kwadilwe.
RULES_COURT_TEXT: Boleele jwa 30.5 m le bophara jwa 15.25 m, ka dikarolo di le tharo. Fa gare go na le sediko sa bogare sa 0.9 m, mme kwa bofelong bongwe le bongwe sediko sa kolo: halofo ya sediko ya 4.9 m go tswa kwa paleng. Reng e kwa godimo ga 3.05 m, go se na boto.
RULES_TEAMS_TEXT: Motshameki mongwe le mongwe o apara bib e e nang le boemo jwa gagwe, mme o tsena fela mo mafelong a boemo joo. Setlhopha se ka kwadisa go fitlha go ba 12; diphetogo di dirwa ka nako ya boikhutso, morago ga kolo fa go kopilwe, le fa go na le kgobalo.
RULES_GOAL_TEXT: Ke GS le GA fela ba ba ka tsenyang kolo, mme fela ba le mo teng ga sediko sa kolo. Bolo e tshwanetse go feta ka mo reng ka botlalo. Go thuntsha go go tswang mo diatleng tsa gagwe pele ga phala go a bala.
RULES_CENTRE_TEXT: Kotara nngwe le nngwe e simolola ka centre pass, le motshameko morago ga kolo nngwe le nngwe. Di a refosanya, go sa kgathalesege gore ke mang yo o tsentseng kolo. C o ema mo sedikong sa bogare; ba bangwe ba emela mo dikarolong tsa bone tsa kolo go fitlha phala e lla, mme pase e tshwanetse go tshwarwa mo karolong ya bogare.
RULES_TIME_TEXT: Dikotara di le nne tsa metsotso e 15, ka metsotso e 4 fa gare ga ya ntlha le ya bobedi, le ya boraro le ya bone, le metsotso e 12 ka halofo. Ditlhopha di refosanya mahlakore kotara nngwe le nngwe.
RULES_EXTRA_TEXT: Fa motshameko o tshwanetse go nna le mofenyi mme ditlhopha di lekana: dihalofo di le pedi tsa go fitlha go metsotso e 7, ka motsotso o le mongwe fa gare ga tsone, morago motshameko o tswelela go fitlha setlhopha sengwe se etelela pele ka dikolo di le pedi.
RULES_FOOTWORK_TEXT: Fa a tshwere bolo ga a letlelelwe go taboga. Lonao lo a fologelang mo go lone ke lonao lwa gagwe lwa go fologa: a ka gata ka lo lengwe mme a dikologa mo go lone, mme fa a sena go lo tsholetsa o tshwanetse go fetisa kgotsa go thuntsha pele lo ama fa fatshe gape. Pase ya mahala go setlhopha se sengwe.
RULES_THREE_TEXT: O tshwanetse go fetisa kgotsa go thuntsha mo metsotswaneng e meraro morago ga go tshwara bolo. Held ball: pase ya mahala.
RULES_OBSTRUCTION_TEXT: Mosireletsi yo o lekang go kganela kgotsa go thopa bolo o tshwanetse go ema bonnye 0.9 m go tswa mo lonaong lwa go fologa lwa motshameki yo o nang le bolo. Fa a le gaufi go feta foo, ke kganelo (obstruction): pase ya kotlhao.
RULES_CONTACT_TEXT: Ga go letlelelwe go thulana mo go kgoreletsang motshameko wa moganetsi: go kgarametsa, go tshwara, go itaya bolo mo diatleng tsa gagwe, kgotsa go sa neye motshameki yo o thopileng bolo sebaka sa go fologa. Pase ya kotlhao.
RULES_OFFSIDE_TEXT: Motshameki yo o tsenang mo lefelong le boemo jwa gagwe bo sa le letleng, a na le bolo kgotsa a se na yone, o offside. Mela ke karolo ya mafelo a e a dikologileng. Pase ya mahala.
RULES_THIRD_TEXT: Bolo ga e a tshwanela go latlhelwa go tlola karolo yotlhe kwa ntle ga gore motshameki yo o mo karolong eo a e tshware kgotsa a e ame. Pase ya mahala.
RULES_SHORT_TEXT: Go tshwanetse go nna le sebaka sa gore moganetsi a thope bolo fa gare ga yo o e latlhelang le yo o e tshwarang. Pase ya mahala.
RULES_OUT_TEXT: Bolo e e wela kwa ntle ga lebala e ya kwa setlhopheng se se sa e amang la bofelo: throw-in go tswa fa e tlotseng mola teng, e tsewa mo metsotswaneng e meraro.
RULES_PENALTIES: Dipase tsa mahala le tsa kotlhao
RULES_PENALTIES_TEXT: Pase ya mahala e tsewa fa phoso e diragetseng teng, ke motshameki ope yo o letleletsweng go nna foo. Mo paseng ya kotlhao, motshameki yo o otlhaiwang o ema fa thoko ga yo o latlhelang, a sa tshameke, go fitlha bolo e latlhelwa. Mo sedikong sa kolo, kotlhao e ka nna pase kgotsa go thuntsha.
RULES_ADVANTAGE_TEXT: Motsereganyi o letla motshameko go tswelela fa go o emisa go ka latlhegela setlhopha se se diretsweng phoso: sekai, GS yo o setseng a thuntsha. O bolela monyetla le phoso.
RULES_SANCTIONS_TEXT: Ka ntlha ya motshameko o o boeleditsweng kgotsa o o kotsi, motsereganyi a ka tlhagisa motshameki, a mo emisa metsotso e mebedi ya nako ya motshameko, kgotsa a mo ntsha. Go simolola ka 2024 ga go sa na toss-up: fa batshameki ba babedi ba dira phoso ka nako e le nngwe, setlhopha se se neng se na le bolo la bofelo se a e boloka.
RULES_DZ_TEXT: Diliki dingwe di tshameka ka diphetogo. Motshameko ono o neela Double Zone: mo metsotsong e metlhano ya bofelo ya kotara nngwe le nngwe, kolo e e tswang 3 m kgotsa go feta go tswa kwa paleng e na le dintlha di le pedi.
CTRL_MOVE_TEXT: Monwana o motona wa molema gongwe le gongwe mo letlhakoreng la molema la sekirini ke joystick: o tsamaisa motshameki wa gago (reng e tala). Taboga o ya mo sebakeng se se se nang motho gore o gololesege go amogela pase.
CTRL_PASS_TEXT: Fa a tshwere bolo ga a kgone go taboga. Sunya joystick go ya kwa mogaabo go mo tlhopha (reng e bontsha gore ke mang), go tswa foo FETISA ya pase ya sehuba kgotsa ya legetla, kgotsa TSHOLETSA go feta godimo ga mosireletsi. Reng e e godimo ga bolo ke metsotswana ya gago e meraro.
CTRL_SHOOT_TEXT: THUNTSHA e tlhagelela fa GS kgotsa GA wa gago a na le bolo mo teng ga sediko. Fa a le gaufi go bonolo; letsogo la mosireletsi godimo ga bolo le dira gore go nne thata.
CTRL_DEFEND_TEXT: SIRELETSA e tsholetsa matsogo a gago godimo ga bolo. Leba reng e e dikologileng lonao lwa gagwe lwa go fologa: e tala e mo molaong, e khibidu e gaufi go feta 0.9 m mme motsereganyi o tla letsa kganelo.
CTRL_INTERCEPT_TEXT: THOPA e tlolela pase e e mo moweng fa o ka e fitlhelela ka nako. Fa o itatlhela mo motshameking yo o tshwereng bolo, ke go thulana.
CTRL_PLAY_AS: Setlhopha kgotsa boemo bo le bongwe
CTRL_PLAY_AS_TEXT: Fa o tshameka jaaka setlhopha, o laola motshameki yo o nang le bolo, mme FETOLA e go isa kwa mosireletsing yo o gaufi le yone. Tlhopha bib mo sekirining sa gae go tshameka boemo bo le bongwe motshameko otlhe.
CTRL_KEYS_TEXT: WASD kgotsa metsu go tsamaya, Space ya konopo ya ntlha, J le K tsa tse dingwe, Esc go emisa.
GOAL_TWO: Kolo ya dintlha di le pedi!
AWARD_PENALTY_SHOT: Pase ya kotlhao kgotsa go thuntsha
EXTRA_TIME_BREAK: Nako e e okeditsweng: refosanyang mahlakore
INTERVAL_NOTE: Boikhutso ke metsotso e {min}; Tswelela e simolola {next} jaanong.
TEAM_CHANGES_NOTE: Tobetsa boemo go tsenya motshameki yo o latelang mo bencheng yo o tshamekang boemo joo.
CUP_ABOUT: Dinaga di le robedi tse di gaufi le ya gago mo maemong a lefatshe, mo ditlhopheng di le pedi tsa di le nne. Tse pedi tsa ntlha mo setlhopheng sengwe le sengwe di ya kwa semi-final; go latela final le motshameko wa boronse. Dintlha di le pedi tsa phenyo, nngwe ya go lekana; fa di lekana go lebiwa diperesente tsa dikolo.
CUP_OUT: O ntshitswe. Kopi e tswelela kwa ntle ga gago.
RECORDS_EMPTY: Tshameka motshameko mme direkoto tsa gago di simolola fano.
REC_TOP_SHOOTER: Dikolo di le dintsi mo motshamekong o le mongwe
REC_CUPS: Dikopi tsa Dinaga tse di gapilweng
TIMEOUTS_NOTE: Molao wa liki: setlhopha sengwe le sengwe se ka kopa di-time-out di le pedi tsa metsotswana e 90 mo halofong nngwe le nngwe, morago ga kolo. Ya gago e mo menyung ya go emisa.
ROLLING_NOTE: Molao wa liki: dira diphetogo tsa setlhopha nako nngwe le nngwe go tswa mo menyung ya go emisa, e seng fela ka nako ya boikhutso.
TIME_OUT_NOTE: Metsotswana e 90, nako e emisitswe. Dira diphetogo tsa setlhopha jaanong; Tswelela fa o setse o ipaakantse.
INJURY_NOTE: Motshameki wa {team} o gobetse. Setlhopha se na le metsotswana e 30 go mo thusa go tswa; ditlhopha tsoopedi di ka dira diphetogo. Tswelela fa o setse o ipaakantse.
